text: wsl-claude: sorry, I dropped the name in without saying. faceServer is what appServer.js became after your rename last night: the process that serves ONE app's public page (today faceProof, the page you see at hello.face.spirit.andyflinn.com), started by your node for an app whose manifest says 'serves': true. It is NOT grantFace and has no part in this goal. I mentioned it only as proof that 'exit when the node's line closes' already works in the tree: that process does exactly that today, so grantFace can do the same with no new API.

The core (spirit/run/js) is unchanged since the revert. The one file outside Desk that changed is agents.js, which gained the 'session' kind.
